_note: Chapter 14 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: Mathematics is full of abstract ideas that seem to have nothing to do with everyday life.
ex.cn: 数学里有大量抽象的概念，看起来与日常生活毫无关系。
ex.note: abstract ideas 抽象概念；abstract art 抽象派艺术

ex.en: Please write an abstract of three hundred words for the conference.
ex.cn: 请为会议写一份三百字的摘要。
ex.note: an abstract of … …的摘要；in the abstract 抽象地说

ex.en: She worked hard to achieve her goal of running a marathon.
ex.cn: 她刻苦训练，实现了自己跑马拉松的目标。
ex.note: achieve a goal 实现目标；achieve success 取得成功

ex.en: An adolescent boy sat in the corner, pretending to read.
ex.cn: 一个少年坐在角落里，假装在看书。
ex.note: adolescent development 青春期发育

ex.en: Adolescent athletes need plenty of sleep and good food.
ex.cn: 青少年运动员需要充足的睡眠和良好的饮食。
ex.note: adolescent health 青少年健康；adolescent stage 青春期

ex.en: I agree with you, but the schedule is far too tight.
ex.cn: 我同意你的看法，不过这个日程实在太紧了。
ex.note: agree with sb. 同意某人；agree to a plan 同意某项计划

ex.en: The mountain village lies at an altitude of two thousand metres.
ex.cn: 这个山村坐落在海拔两千米处。
ex.note: at an altitude of … 海拔为…

ex.en: The manager's announcement about the new schedule surprised the whole office.
ex.cn: 经理关于新日程的宣布让整个办公室都吃了一惊。
ex.note: make an announcement 宣布；announcement of … …的公告

ex.en: The kitchen was full of modern appliances, from ovens to dishwashers.
ex.cn: 厨房里摆满了现代电器，从烤箱到洗碗机一应俱全。
ex.note: household appliances 家用电器

ex.en: On his arrival in the city, he wrote a long letter home.
ex.cn: 抵达这座城市后，他给家里写了一封长信。
ex.note: on arrival 抵达时；the arrival of … …的到来

ex.en: The size of the library astonished every visitor.
ex.cn: 图书馆的规模让每一位参观者都吃了一惊。
ex.note: be astonished at/by 对…感到惊讶

ex.en: They walked down a wide avenue lined with plane trees.
ex.cn: 他们沿着一条两旁种着梧桐的宽阔大街走去。
ex.note: an avenue of success 成功之路

ex.en: He banged the table with his fist to get their attention.
ex.cn: 他用拳头捶桌子，想引起他们的注意。
ex.note: bang on the door 砰砰敲门；with a bang 砰的一声

ex.en: A beam of sunlight crossed the room and lit up the old piano.
ex.cn: 一束阳光穿过房间，照亮了那架旧钢琴。
ex.note: a beam of light 一道光；a beam of joy 笑容

ex.en: She beamed with pleasure when she saw the result.
ex.cn: 看到结果时，她高兴得眉开眼笑。
ex.note: beam with joy 眉开眼笑；beam with pride 眉飞色舞

ex.en: The temperature fell below zero and the pipes froze.
ex.cn: 气温降到零度以下，水管结了冰。
ex.note: below zero 零度以下；below the age of 未满…岁

ex.en: The coffee was bitter, but he drank it anyway.
ex.cn: 咖啡很苦，他还是把它喝了下去。
ex.note: a bitter taste 苦味；bitter disappointment 深深的失望

ex.en: The company paid a bonus to every member of the team.
ex.cn: 公司给团队里的每个人都发了一份奖金。
ex.note: a bonus on sth. 某方面的额外好处

ex.en: They had breakfast in the kitchen at seven every morning.
ex.cn: 他们每天早上七点在厨房吃早饭。
ex.note: have breakfast 吃早餐；breakfast meeting 早餐会

ex.en: The extra work became a real burden for the whole team.
ex.cn: 额外的工作成了整个团队真正的负担。
ex.note: a burden on … …的负担；bear a burden 承担重担

ex.en: Rising costs burdened the small company with heavy debts.
ex.cn: 成本上涨让这家小公司背上了沉重的债务。
ex.note: be burdened with 背负；使苦于

ex.en: A camel stood quietly in the shade, chewing some dry grass.
ex.cn: 一头骆驼安静地站在树荫下，嚼着干草。
ex.note: a camel caravan 骆驼队

ex.en: She handed him a carrot and told him to eat more vegetables.
ex.cn: 她递给他一根胡萝卜，让他多吃点蔬菜。
ex.note: carrot and stick 胡萝卜加大棒

ex.en: The temperature reached thirty-five degrees centigrade by noon.
ex.cn: 到中午，气温已经达到三十五摄氏度。
ex.note: degrees centigrade 摄氏度

ex.en: A tear rolled down her cheek when the music started.
ex.cn: 音乐响起时，一滴泪顺着她的脸颊滑了下来。
ex.note: tears to the cheek 含泪；cheek by jowl 肩并肩地

ex.en: They stopped for a drink at a small cinema on the corner.
ex.cn: 他们在街角的一家小电影院旁停下来喝了点东西。
ex.note: go to the cinema 去看电影

ex.en: The city's summer climate is hot and uncomfortably humid.
ex.cn: 这座城市的夏季气候炎热，湿气逼人。
ex.note: a pleasant climate 宜人的气候；political climate 政治气候

ex.en: He entered college in September to study engineering.
ex.cn: 他九月进入大学，开始学工程。
ex.note: go to college 上大学；a college of … …的学院

ex.en: The second half of the game was comparable to a final.
ex.cn: 比赛的下半场堪比决赛。
ex.note: comparable to 与…相比；be comparable to 相当于

ex.en: The work required long hours of absolute concentration.
ex.cn: 这份工作需要长时间全神贯注。
ex.note: concentration on sth. 专注于某事；a concentration of … …的集中

ex.en: He lied about the delay, and it weighed on his conscience.
ex.cn: 他谎报了延误的事，这一直压在他良心上。
ex.note: a guilty conscience 内疚；on one's conscience 良心不安

ex.en: The train crossed the whole continent in three days.
ex.cn: 火车三天就横穿了整个大陆。
ex.note: the European continent 欧洲大陆

ex.en: The farmer grows corn and wheat on the flat plain.
ex.cn: 农民在这片平坦的平原上种玉米和小麦。
ex.note: sweet corn 甜玉米；corn on the cob 煮玉米

ex.en: Snow covered the whole street by morning.
ex.cn: 到早晨，积雪盖住了整条街。
ex.note: be covered with/by 被…覆盖；cover up 掩盖

ex.en: The date should be printed on the front cover of the book.
ex.cn: 日期应该印在书的封面上。
ex.note: on the cover of … 在…的封面上；take cover 躲避

ex.en: The next ten days were crucial to the whole project.
ex.cn: 接下来的十天对整个项目至关重要。
ex.note: be crucial to/for 对…至关重要

ex.en: She wrote a short report in the daily log every evening.
ex.cn: 她每天傍晚都在日志里写一小段记录。
ex.note: daily report 日报；daily routine 日常惯例

ex.en: The nurse came in twice daily to check on him.
ex.cn: 护士每天来两次查看他的情况。
ex.note: daily + 动词 每天…

ex.en: The old wooden stairs were beginning to decay.
ex.cn: 那段旧木楼梯已经开始朽坏。
ex.note: tooth decay 蛀牙；decay into 腐烂成

ex.en: The instrument is delicate and must be handled with care.
ex.cn: 这台仪器很精密，必须小心轻放。
ex.note: a delicate instrument 精密仪器；a delicate balance 微妙的平衡

ex.en: He had a strong desire to see the sea again.
ex.cn: 他强烈地想再看一次大海。
ex.note: a desire for sth. 对某物的渴望；at the desire of 应…的请求

ex.en: Many students desire to study abroad after college.
ex.cn: 许多学生想在大学毕业后出国留学。
ex.note: desire to do sth. 渴望做某事

ex.en: He carried a small English dictionary everywhere he went.
ex.cn: 无论走到哪儿，他都带着一本小英语词典。
ex.note: look up a word in the dictionary 在词典里查词

ex.en: The flood was a disaster for the whole village.
ex.cn: 这场洪水对整个村子来说是一场灾难。
ex.note: a walking disaster 彻底的失败

ex.en: Volunteers distributed food and water to the residents.
ex.cn: 志愿者向居民分发食物和水。
ex.note: distribute sth. to sb. 把某物分发给某人

ex.en: He had no doubt that the plan would work.
ex.cn: 他毫不怀疑这个计划会成功。
ex.note: no doubt 毫无疑问；beyond doubt 毫无疑问

ex.en: I doubt whether anyone can finish it in one evening.
ex.cn: 我怀疑有没有人能在今晚把它做完。
ex.note: doubt whether/if … 怀疑是否…

ex.en: He got drunk at the party and could hardly walk straight.
ex.cn: 他在聚会上喝醉了，连路都走不直。
ex.note: be drunk 醉酒；drunk on sth. 因某事沉醉

ex.en: He heard an echo of laughter from the next room.
ex.cn: 他听见隔壁房间里传来一阵笑声的回响。
ex.note: the echo of … …的回声；come back like an echo 余音绕梁

ex.en: The applause echoed through the empty street.
ex.cn: 掌声在空荡荡的街道上回荡。
ex.note: echo with 回荡着

ex.en: The staff held an election for a new representative.
ex.cn: 员工们举行了一次选举，选出新的职工代表。
ex.note: hold an election 举行选举；general election 大选

ex.en: His employer paid for the trip home.
ex.cn: 他的雇主替他付了回家的路费。
ex.note: a large employer 大型雇主

ex.en: The entire team stayed late to finish the work.
ex.cn: 整个团队都留下来加班，把工作做完。
ex.note: the entire + 复数名词 整个…

ex.en: After many attempts, he eventually fixed the program.
ex.cn: 尝试了很多次之后，他终于把程序修好了。
ex.note: eventually + 句子 终于

ex.en: The price excludes breakfast and service.
ex.cn: 价格不含早餐和服务费。
ex.note: exclude sb./sth. from … 把…排除在外

ex.en: They extended the deadline by two weeks.
ex.cn: 他们把期限延长了两周。
ex.note: extend sth. 延长某物；extend a welcome to 欢迎

ex.en: The streets soon became familiar to him.
ex.cn: 这些街道很快就让他觉得熟悉了。
ex.note: be familiar with 熟悉；familiar to sb. 为某人所熟悉

ex.en: She was fearful of making mistakes in front of the manager.
ex.cn: 她害怕在经理面前出错。
ex.note: be fearful of 害怕…；be fearful for 为…担心

ex.en: The contract is in the file under the letter C.
ex.cn: 合同在档案里，归在字母 C 下面。
ex.note: in the file 在档案中；file cabinet 文件柜

ex.en: Please file the report before you leave tonight.
ex.cn: 今晚离开前请把这份报告归档。
ex.note: file a report 归档报告；file for sth. 申请某物

ex.en: The office was flexible about working hours.
ex.cn: 办公室对上下班时间很灵活。
ex.note: flexible working hours 弹性工时；flexible schedule 灵活安排

ex.en: The forecast says it will rain all weekend.
ex.cn: 天气预报说整个周末都有雨。
ex.note: weather forecast 天气预报

ex.en: The old window frame had been painted white.
ex.cn: 那扇旧窗框被刷成了白色。
ex.note: door/window frame 门/窗框；frame of mind 心境

ex.en: The gallery framed the photograph and hung it on the wall.
ex.cn: 画廊给照片配了框，挂在了墙上。
ex.note: frame a picture 给照片装框；frame sb. for sth. 陷害某人

ex.en: There was a fundamental difference between the two designs.
ex.cn: 两种设计之间有着根本的区别。
ex.note: be fundamental to 对…至关重要；fundamental change 根本性变化

ex.en: The fundamentals of the theory are easy to grasp.
ex.cn: 这个理论的基本原理很容易理解。
ex.note: the fundamentals of … …的基本原理

ex.en: Generally, the office is quiet in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 一般来说，办公室下午都很安静。
ex.note: generally speaking 一般来说

ex.en: The bus goes to the city centre every ten minutes.
ex.cn: 公交车每十分钟开往市中心一趟。
ex.note: go by 经过；going from bad to worse 每况愈下

ex.en: The university granted her a scholarship to study abroad.
ex.cn: 学校给了她一份出国深造的奖学金。
ex.note: grant sb. sth. 授予某人某物；grant that… 承认…

ex.en: He received a small grant to pay for his research.
ex.cn: 他得到了一小笔资助，用来支付研究费用。
ex.note: research grant 研究经费；grant application 资助申请

ex.en: Her guidance helped me through my first year.
ex.cn: 她的指导帮我度过了第一年。
ex.note: under the guidance of 在…的指导下

ex.en: The final examination was harder than she had expected.
ex.cn: 期末考试比她预想的难。
ex.note: a hard choice 艰难的选择；hard work 努力

ex.en: He worked hard to finish the report on time.
ex.cn: 他努力工作，按时完成了报告。
ex.note: work hard 努力；hard to believe 难以相信

ex.en: The summer heat made it hard to fall asleep.
ex.cn: 夏天的酷热让人难以入睡。
ex.note: in the heat 在酷热中；the heat of the moment 一时激动

ex.en: Please heat the milk before you serve it.
ex.cn: 请把牛奶加热再端上来。
ex.note: heat up 加热；heated debate 激烈的争论

ex.en: She waited for him at the gate for nearly an hour.
ex.cn: 她在门口等了他将近一个小时。
ex.note: him / them 指代前面提到的人

ex.en: A horn sounded behind them and they jumped aside.
ex.cn: 身后响起一阵喇叭声，他们赶紧跳到一边。
ex.note: a car horn 汽车喇叭；horn of plenty 富足之源

ex.en: They lived in a small hut near the edge of the village.
ex.cn: 他们住在村子边上的一间小屋里。
ex.note: a fishing hut 渔屋

ex.en: No one is immune to the pressure of the exam season.
ex.cn: 考试季的压力，谁都无法免疫。
ex.note: be immune to 对…免疫／不受…影响

ex.en: Look up the model number in the index at the back.
ex.cn: 在后面的索引里查一下型号编号。
ex.note: an index to sth. 对某物的索引；index finger 食指

ex.en: The inner walls of the machine were covered in dust.
ex.cn: 机器的内壁上积着灰尘。
ex.note: inner thoughts 内心想法；the inner circle 核心圈子

ex.en: The work demanded intense concentration.
ex.cn: 这份工作需要高度专注。
ex.note: intense heat 酷热；intense pressure 巨大的压力

ex.en: The job involves testing the machine under extreme heat.
ex.cn: 这份工作包括在极端高温下测试机器。
ex.note: involve doing sth. 包含做某事；involve sb. in sth. 使某人参与某事

ex.en: His face was full of joy when the news arrived.
ex.cn: 消息传来时，他满脸喜色。
ex.note: with joy 欣喜地；the joy of … …的快乐

ex.en: They cooked dinner together in the small kitchen.
ex.cn: 他们一起在那间小厨房里做了晚饭。
ex.note: kitchen table 餐桌；in the kitchen 在厨房里

ex.en: The train arrived late because of the storm.
ex.cn: 因为暴风雨，火车晚点了。
ex.note: run late 迟到；late last night 昨晚很晚

ex.en: She left the office at six and took the bus home.
ex.cn: 她六点离开办公室，坐公交回了家。
ex.note: leave for 动身前往；leave sth. to sb. 把某事留给某人

ex.en: The company gave every worker a month's leave.
ex.cn: 公司给每个员工一个月的假期。
ex.note: on leave 休假；take a leave 请假

ex.en: She likes reading in the park on quiet afternoons.
ex.cn: 她喜欢在安静的午后到公园里读书。
ex.note: would like to do 想要做某事；look like 看起来像

ex.en: He ran like the wind across the field.
ex.cn: 他像风一样跑过田野。
ex.note: like/as 一样；it is like … 就像是…

ex.en: Remember to lock the lab before you leave.
ex.cn: 记得离开前锁好实验室。
ex.note: lock the door 锁门；lock oneself in 把自己关在里面

ex.en: The old gate was fitted with a heavy iron lock.
ex.cn: 那扇旧门上装着一把沉重的铁锁。
ex.note: a padlock 挂锁；under lock and key 严加保管

ex.en: A luxury hotel stood at the end of the avenue.
ex.cn: 大街尽头矗立着一家豪华酒店。
ex.note: a luxury car 豪车；luxury goods 奢侈品

ex.en: The company is a large manufacturer of kitchen appliances.
ex.cn: 这家公司是一家大型厨房电器制造商。
ex.note: car manufacturer 汽车制造商

ex.en: I still do not know the meaning of that last sentence.
ex.cn: 最后那句话的意思我还是没弄懂。
ex.note: the meaning of … …的含义；meaningful 有意义的

ex.en: My room was in a mess after the trip.
ex.cn: 旅行回来后，我的房间乱七八糟。
ex.note: in a mess 乱七八糟；make a mess of 把…搞砸

ex.en: Don't mess with the wires while the machine is running.
ex.cn: 机器运转的时候别乱动那些线路。
ex.note: mess with 乱动；mess about 胡闹

ex.en: A wrong number on the screen can mislead the user.
ex.cn: 屏幕上出错的一个数字会误导用户。
ex.note: mislead sb. about sth. 在某事上误导某人

ex.en: The plan is simple; moreover, it costs almost nothing.
ex.cn: 这个方案很简单，而且几乎不花钱。
ex.note: moreover = besides 而且；此外

ex.en: You must not touch the equipment without permission.
ex.cn: 未经许可你不能碰这台设备。
ex.note: must be 一定是；mustn't 表示禁止

ex.en: We need more time to finish the tests.
ex.cn: 我们需要更多时间来完成测试。
ex.note: need to do sth. 需要做某事；there is a need for 对…有需求

ex.en: He asked who was in charge, but no one answered.
ex.cn: 他问是谁负责，可没有人回答。
ex.note: no one 没有人；not…no… 也不…

ex.en: No student passed the final test.
ex.cn: 没有一个学生通过了期末测验。
ex.note: no + 名词 没有…；no longer 不再

ex.en: The noise from the building site was a real nuisance.
ex.cn: 工地上的噪声实在让人烦。
ex.note: a nuisance to sb. 对某人是麻烦事

ex.en: He took his coat off and hung it by the door.
ex.cn: 他脱下外套，挂在门边。
ex.note: take off 脱下；switch off 关掉；far off 远离

ex.en: The milk smells off and should be thrown away.
ex.cn: 牛奶闻起来已经坏了，应当扔掉。
ex.note: go off 变质；off-duty 休假的

ex.en: Many parents oppose the plan to close the old school.
ex.cn: 许多家长反对关闭那所老学校的计划。
ex.note: oppose sth./doing 反对某事；be opposed to 反对

ex.en: The outer casing was covered with a thin cloth.
ex.cn: 外壳上盖着一层薄布。
ex.note: outer space 外太空；the outer wall 外墙

ex.en: He felt a sharp pain in his shoulder after the match.
ex.cn: 比赛之后，他感到肩膀一阵剧痛。
ex.note: a pain in the neck 讨厌的事；painful 痛苦的

ex.en: The wound pained him all night long.
ex.cn: 那道伤口让他疼了整整一夜。
ex.note: pain sb. 使某人疼痛

ex.en: He soon found a partner to share the work with.
ex.cn: 他很快找到了一个可以分担工作的搭档。
ex.note: business partner 生意伙伴；a partner in crime 同谋

ex.en: As a student he was always competing with his peers.
ex.cn: 作为学生，他总是和同龄人争高下。
ex.note: one's peers 同龄人；peer pressure 同伴压力

ex.en: She peered through the window to see who was inside.
ex.cn: 她透过窗户往里看，想看清里面是谁。
ex.note: peer at 细看；peer through 透过…看

ex.en: The office cat was the pet of the whole team.
ex.cn: 办公室那只猫是整个团队的宠物。
ex.note: a pet dog 宠物狗；pet owner 宠物主人

ex.en: She bent down to pet the puppy behind the desk.
ex.cn: 她弯下腰去抚摸办公桌后面的小狗。
ex.note: pet an animal 抚摸动物

ex.en: She bought a pink cushion for the office cat.
ex.cn: 她给办公室的猫买了一个粉红色的垫子。
ex.note: in the pink 身体健康；pink slip 解雇通知

ex.en: He read a page of modern poetry aloud to the class.
ex.cn: 他给全班朗读了一页现代诗。
ex.note: Chinese poetry 中国诗歌；poetry reading 诗歌朗诵

ex.en: The new policy poses a serious problem for small firms.
ex.cn: 这项新政策给小公司带来了严重难题。
ex.note: pose a problem/threat 构成问题／威胁；pose as 冒充

ex.en: She struck a graceful pose in front of the mirror.
ex.cn: 她在镜子前摆出一个优雅的姿势。
ex.note: strike a pose 摆姿势

ex.en: The sensor must give precise readings at all times.
ex.cn: 传感器必须随时给出精确的读数。
ex.note: precise measurements 精确测量；to be precise 精确地说

ex.en: The principal reason for the delay was a small error in the program.
ex.cn: 延迟的主要原因是程序里一个小小的错误。
ex.note: the principal reason 主要原因；principal and minor 主要和次要的

ex.en: The principal of the school spoke to the new students.
ex.cn: 校长向新生们讲话。
ex.note: school principal 校长；principal and interest 本金和利息

ex.en: He promised to finish the report before Friday.
ex.cn: 他保证在周五之前完成报告。
ex.note: promise to do sth. 承诺做某事；promising 有希望的

ex.en: The interview is full of promise, though nothing is certain yet.
ex.cn: 这次面试很有希望，尽管一切都还不确定。
ex.note: show promise 有前途；a promise of … …的承诺

ex.en: The company published the results on its website.
ex.cn: 公司把结果发布在了自己的网站上。
ex.note: publish a book 出版书；publish an article 发表文章

ex.en: I was quite sure that I had left the file at home.
ex.cn: 我很确定自己把文件落在家里了。
ex.note: quite a few 相当多；quite good 相当不错

ex.en: The lab reacted with a cheer when the bug was fixed.
ex.cn: 缺陷修好的时候，实验室里爆发出一阵欢呼。
ex.note: react to 对…作出反应；react with 以…回应

ex.en: Her recovery from the operation took a full two months.
ex.cn: 她术后恢复花了整整两个月。
ex.note: a quick recovery 快速康复；economic recovery 经济复苏

ex.en: This company has no relation to the firm mentioned earlier.
ex.cn: 这家公司与前面提到的那家商行毫无关系。
ex.note: in relation to 关于；a close relation 近亲

ex.en: She reported the bug to her manager that afternoon.
ex.cn: 那天下午她把缺陷报告给了经理。
ex.note: report to 向…汇报；report on 就…作报告

ex.en: He needed a good rest after the long journey.
ex.cn: 长途旅行之后，他需要好好休息。
ex.note: at rest 休息；the rest of 剩下的

ex.en: The old gate rested on two stone pillars.
ex.cn: 那扇旧门由两根石柱支撑着。
ex.note: rest on 支撑；rest against 倚靠

ex.en: A gold ring hung from her finger.
ex.cn: 一枚金戒指挂在她手指上。
ex.note: a wedding ring 婚戒；ring road 环城路

ex.en: The phone kept ringing all evening with questions from customers.
ex.cn: 电话整个晚上都在响，全是客户打来问问题的。
ex.note: ring sb. up 给某人打电话；ring the bell 鸣铃

ex.en: He rubbed his eyes and took another look at the screen.
ex.cn: 他揉了揉眼睛，又看了一眼屏幕。
ex.note: rub against 摩擦；rub sth. up 擦亮

ex.en: Sand from the building site blew into their faces.
ex.cn: 工地上的沙子扑到他们脸上。
ex.note: a sand dune 沙丘；sand in the wheels 障碍

ex.en: She wanted to study science at college.
ex.cn: 她想上大学学理科。
ex.note: natural science 自然科学；science fiction 科幻

ex.en: The numbers seemed to move as he stared at them.
ex.cn: 他盯着看的时候，那些数字似乎都在动。
ex.note: seem to do sth. 似乎做某事；It seems that 看起来

ex.en: He was seventeen and already taller than his father.
ex.cn: 他十七岁，个头已经超过了父亲。
ex.note: seventeen years old 十七岁

ex.en: A small shop sells fruit and vegetables at the corner.
ex.cn: 街角有一家小店卖水果和蔬菜。
ex.note: a corner shop 街角小店；workshop 车间

ex.en: They shopped for a whole afternoon in the new shopping centre.
ex.cn: 他们在新的购物中心里买了一下午的东西。
ex.note: go shopping 去购物；shop for sth. 选购某物

ex.en: It was a silly question, but nobody laughed at him.
ex.cn: 那是个傻问题，可没人嘲笑他。
ex.note: silly mistake 愚蠢的错误；look silly 看起来傻

ex.en: She wore a white shirt and a grey skirt to the office.
ex.cn: 她穿着白衬衫和一条灰裙子来上班。
ex.note: a long skirt 长裙；on the edge of the skirt 裙边

ex.en: They played soccer in the corridor after lunch.
ex.cn: 午饭后他们在走廊里踢足球。
ex.note: play soccer 踢足球；soccer player 足球运动员

ex.en: There was sorrow in the goodbye, but also a kind of joy.
ex.cn: 告别里有悲伤，也有一份欢喜。
ex.note: deep sorrow 深切的悲伤；in sorrow 悲伤地

ex.en: The train picked up speed as it left the station.
ex.cn: 火车驶离车站时速度越来越快。
ex.note: at high speed 以高速；speed limit 限速

ex.en: The old car cannot speed up on this road.
ex.cn: 这辆旧车在这条路上加速不起来。
ex.note: speed up 加速；speed along 疾驰

ex.en: At this stage the product was ready for the market.
ex.cn: 到这个阶段，产品已经可以推向市场了。
ex.note: at an early stage 在早期；a stage of the process 流程的一个阶段

ex.en: The company staged the launch in a small hotel.
ex.cn: 公司在一家小酒店里举办了上市发布会。
ex.note: stage a show/launch 举办演出／发布会

ex.en: The weather was hot and sticky all week.
ex.cn: 整整一周天气都闷热黏腻。
ex.note: sticky tape 胶带；a sticky situation 棘手的处境

ex.en: He was under a great deal of stress during the last week.
ex.cn: 最后那一周他压力很大。
ex.note: under stress 在压力下；stress test 压力测试

ex.en: The teacher stressed the importance of the deadline.
ex.cn: 老师强调了这个截止日期的重要性。
ex.note: stress the importance of 强调…的重要性

ex.en: The machine sucks in air and heats it up.
ex.cn: 这台机器把空气吸进来再加热。
ex.note: suck in 吸入；suck up to 巴结

ex.en: The old bridge is supported by two stone pillars.
ex.cn: 那座老桥由两根石柱支撑着。
ex.note: support sb./sth. 支持某人／某物

ex.en: Her advice was a great support to me that year.
ex.cn: 那年她的建议对我是一个莫大的支持。
ex.note: a support to sb. 对某人的支持；support system 支撑系统

ex.en: A sword hung above the door on the old wall.
ex.cn: 老墙上，一扇门的上方横着一把剑。
ex.note: sword and shield 剑与盾；sword of justice 正义之剑

ex.en: A single tear ran down her cheek.
ex.cn: 一滴泪顺着她的脸颊流了下来。
ex.note: in tears 泪流满面；burst into tears 突然大哭

ex.en: Do not tear the photograph; it is the only copy.
ex.cn: 别把照片撕了，那是唯一的一张。
ex.note: tear sth. apart 撕碎；tear up 撕破

ex.en: Each machine is put through a series of tests.
ex.cn: 每台机器都要经过一连串测试。
ex.note: a test of … 对…的考验；pass a test 通过测试

ex.en: We tested the new sensor for two whole weeks.
ex.cn: 我们把新传感器整整测了两个星期。
ex.note: test sth. on sth. 在…上测试某物

ex.en: She finished third in the swimming race.
ex.cn: 她在游泳比赛里拿了第三名。
ex.note: the third of … …的第三个；in the third place 名列第三

ex.en: A tiger slept behind the glass and never moved.
ex.cn: 一只老虎在玻璃后面睡着，一动不动。
ex.note: paper tiger 纸老虎

ex.en: A hammer is the simplest tool in the box.
ex.cn: 锤子是工具箱里最简单的工具。
ex.note: a useful tool 有用的工具；toolbox 工具箱

ex.en: The device transmits the temperature to your phone.
ex.cn: 这个装置把温度传到你的手机上。
ex.note: transmit sth. to sb. 把某物传送给某人

ex.en: Those eight weeks were the hardest and truly the best of his life.
ex.cn: 那八周是他一生中最艰难、也真正最美好的时光。
ex.note: truly believe 真诚地相信；truly grateful 真心感激

ex.en: The machine will undergo a series of tests next week.
ex.cn: 这台机器下周要接受一连串测试。
ex.note: undergo changes 经历变化；undergo treatment 接受治疗

ex.en: He checked the inner and upper panels of the machine.
ex.cn: 他检查了机器内侧和上方的面板。
ex.note: the upper part 上部；upper limit 上限

ex.en: A thin vapor rose from the wet grass.
ex.cn: 湿草上升起一层薄薄的水汽。
ex.note: water vapor 水蒸气；vapour pressure 蒸气压

ex.en: A street musician played the violin outside a bookshop.
ex.cn: 一位街头音乐家在书店门外拉小提琴。
ex.note: play the violin 拉小提琴

ex.en: After work he took a long walk along the beach.
ex.cn: 下班后，他沿着海边散了很久的步。
ex.note: take/go for a walk 散步；walk away 走开

ex.en: The train leaves on Wednesday morning.
ex.cn: 火车在星期三早上发车。
ex.note: on Wednesday 在星期三

ex.en: He picked up the whip and climbed into the cart.
ex.cn: 他拿起鞭子，爬上了马车。
ex.note: a riding whip 骑鞭

ex.en: She whipped the cream until it turned thick.
ex.cn: 她把奶油打发到变稠。
ex.note: whip the cream 打发奶油；whip up 迅速做出

ex.en: I wish you could stay a little longer.
ex.cn: 我真希望你能多留一会儿。
ex.note: I wish + 从句 希望…（与现在事实相反）

ex.en: He made a wish and blew out the candles.
ex.cn: 他许了个愿，然后吹灭了蜡烛。
ex.note: make a wish 许愿；best wishes 祝愿

ex.en: She said she would finish the work by Friday.
ex.cn: 她说她会在周五之前把工作做完。
ex.note: would 表示过去的将来；would like to 想要

ex.en: They spent the whole afternoon at the zoo.
ex.cn: 他们在动物园待了一整个下午。
ex.note: go to the zoo 去动物园
